subject: Familial Alzheimer's Mutations Disrupt Muscle Nerves Without Brain Involvement
script: From Agewell Brief: Familial Alzheimer's Mutations Disrupt Muscle Nerves Without Brain Involvement. In miniature human-on-a-chip circuits lacking a brain or spinal cord, inherited Alzheimer's mutations weakened nerve-to-muscle signaling and accelerated muscle fatigue. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
